aboutGame.title: What is Blue Lock Farm?
paragraphs: Blue Lock Farm is a Roblox tycoon-style idle game from developer Finding Illusions that turns the locker-room energy of the Blue Lock anime into a soccer ball money machine. You buy lockers, hatch anime-inspired players, and let those players farm balls across your base, then sell full crates for Cash and pour the earnings back into better lockers and upgrades.

The loop is simple but the optimization runs deep: crate value, luck, opening speed, movement, and base size upgrades all compound, while Grade Tokens, Trait Tokens, Variant Tokens, and Potions push your best players toward the top UR grade. Our wiki covers every system with step-by-step guides, upgrade priorities, and code lists you can act on right away.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Blue Lock Farm.

items.question: What is Blue Lock Farm?
items.answer: Blue Lock Farm is a Roblox tycoon-style idle game from developer Finding Illusions. You buy lockers, hatch anime-inspired soccer players, let them farm balls into crates, and sell full crates for Cash that funds better lockers and upgrades.

items.question: What is the fastest way to make Cash in Blue Lock Farm?
items.answer: Sell full crates and reinvest in crate value first, then luck. Blue Lock Farm rewards players who keep the loop moving, so fill every locker slot before you log off and upgrade crate value before buying another expensive locker.

items.question: How do Blue Lock Farm codes work?
items.answer: Blue Lock Farm codes are free one-time rewards you enter in the Shop menu. Active codes such as TRAITS, ADMINABUSE, POLISHER, COMMUNITY, and WEATHER hand out Trait Tokens, Grade Tokens, Potions, and Jackpot Tokens.

items.question: What is the best grade in Blue Lock Farm?
items.answer: UR sits at the top of the Blue Lock Farm ranking ladder and carries the biggest Cash multiplier in the game. Roll grades at the Ranking stand in the Plaza, and save Grade Tokens for the players you plan to keep.

items.question: Should I rebirth in Blue Lock Farm?
items.answer: Rebirth resets your lockers, players, and unspent Cash in exchange for permanent bonuses. Spend your Cash, sell full crates, and bank your Grade Tokens before you confirm a Blue Lock Farm rebirth.
